All 50 Nifty 50 stocks, delivery buys, all timeframes, 1 Jan 2023 – 26 Oct 2026 (15/30-min from 1 Dec 2025), FYERS charges only, ₹1,00,000 per trade. Education, not investment advice. Full reports (every timeframe in detail, random-buy comparison, by year, charges by type): ../../../projects/trading-equation-backtests/reports/STRATEGY2_MA_ADX_N50_INTRABAR_REPORT.md (new intra-candle sell) and STRATEGY2_MA_ADX_N50_REPORT.md (old sell-at-close, for comparison). Every trade: reports/strategy2_ma_adx_n50_intrabar/trades_all.csv. One-stock version: strategy2_ma_adx_adaniports.md.

1. The rules

Buy (all on the same candle): MACD histogram bigger than the previous candle · Stoch RSI blue crosses above orange (previous candle blue ≤ orange, this candle blue > orange) · blue below 50 · the version's filter is true · no trade open in that stock → buy at this candle's close.

Sell: from the next candle on, the moment blue crosses below orange while the candle is forming. The code finds the exact price where that happens: if the candle opens below it, sell at the open; if the low reaches it, sell at that price. No stop-loss, no target.

Filters (21 versions): NONE · ADX(14) > 30 · ADX(14) > 40 · A50/A100/A200 = last 5 daily closes above the 50/100/200-day average (intraday timeframes use yesterday's) · B50/B100/B200 = last 5 candles of the traded timeframe above its 50/100/200-candle average · each A and B also with ADX > 30 and ADX > 40.

Charges: FYERS only. Same-day = intraday rates (≈ ₹83 per ₹1L round trip); overnight = delivery rates (≈ ₹284). No slippage. Full rule list: the chat answer of 28 Oct 2026, and the docstring of experiments/strategy2_ma_adx.py.

3. What it shows

  • Every version loses in total because of 15-min, 30-min and 1-hour (−₹3L to −₹31L each). Only 4-hour and daily ever make money.
  • Best: 4-hour + ADX > 30 + any average (A50, A100, B100, B200): +₹88k to +₹97k on 680–760 trades, 23–26 of 50 stocks profitable. They beat random buys with the same filter in 97–100% of runs (random buys lose ~₹80–88k). So on 4-hour, ADX > 30 plus the entry really does pick better moments than chance.
  • But only in 2023–2024. For A50+ADX30 on 4-hour: 2023 +₹52k · 2024 +₹66k · 2025 −₹14k · 2026 −₹7k. Every top version has the same pattern. They make money in the rising market and lose afterwards.
  • ADX 30 vs 40: ADX > 40 leaves too few trades (217–430 on 4-hour) and mostly loses. ADX > 30 is the better level.
  • 50 vs 100 vs 200 average: with ADX > 30 on 4-hour, all of them land at +₹88–97k except A200 (+₹35k). The length matters much less than the ADX filter.
  • Daily average-only (A50/B50 +₹70k) is no better than random buys with the same filter (beats 77%), and it lost ₹81k in 2026.

4. Intra-candle sell vs sell-at-close

  • Over all 105 version × timeframe combinations, the intra-candle sell lost ₹3.36 crore in total vs ₹3.63 crore for sell-at-close. It was better in 66 of 105, but not on 4-hour + ADX30, where sell-at-close was higher (e.g. A50+ADX30 +₹1.49L vs +₹97k).
  • About half the intra-candle sells happen at the open (1,27,611 of 2,58,374): the cross happened during the gap between candles. So getting out "early" often only saves the move inside the candle.

5. Adding +DI above −DI (strong trend that points up) — 4-hour and daily

Same rules, ADX > 30 versions also run with +DI above −DI on the buy candle (ADX, +DI, −DI from TradingView "ADX and DI", same timeframe). Report: reports/STRATEGY2_MA_ADX_N50_INTRABAR_DI_REPORT.md.

  • +DI makes every ADX30 version positive on both timeframes (4-hour +₹26k to +₹58k, daily +₹43k to +₹56k) and makes them much steadier: the 2025–2026 losses shrink to a few thousand rupees. Example: 4-hour B200 + ADX30 + DI: 2023 +₹45k · 2024 +₹31k · 2025 −₹14k · 2026 −₹4.5k, vs −₹12k / −₹16k without +DI.
  • On 4-hour it lowers the total when an average is also used (e.g. A50 + ADX30: +₹97k → +₹39k), because the average already keeps you in uptrends and +DI removes some good trades. It still beats random buys in 97–100% of runs.
  • On daily, the +DI profit is mostly the trend itself: random buys with the same filter make +₹23k to +₹62k, and the strategy beats them only 43–63% of the time.
  • Most consistent version so far: 4-hour B200 + ADX30 + DI: +₹57,808 on 559 trades, 23 of 50 stocks profitable, beats random 100%, +₹11.5k without its best 3 trades, worst year −₹14k. Still a thin edge, about ₹100 per ₹1L trade.

What +DI actually removes from B200 + ADX30

Splitting the B200 + ADX30 trades by +DI vs −DI on the buy candle:

4-hour: +DI above −DI4-hour: +DI below −DI (removed by +DI)Daily: +DI above −DIDaily: +DI below −DI (removed)
Trades55912327586
Avg move+0.38%+0.57%+0.45%−0.02%
Net ₹+57,808+34,699+44,656−26,089
  • B200 already means the stock is above its 200-candle average (a longer uptrend). Inside that, +DI below −DI means a short, strong pullback. Strategy 2's Stoch cross then buys the dip.
  • On 4-hour those dip buys made money (+₹34.7k), so +DI throws away good trades → use B200 + ADX30 without +DI on 4-hour.
  • On daily they lost (−₹26k), so +DI helps → use B200 + ADX30 + DI on daily.

6. Lesson

Of everything tested so far, 4-hour Strategy 2 + ADX > 30 + a 50/100/200 average is the strongest real-time version: it beats random timing and makes about ₹1 lakh over 3.8 years on 50 stocks at ₹1L per trade (≈ ₹130 per trade), but lost money in 2025–2026. Adding +DI above −DI gives less profit (≈ ₹50k) but much smaller losses in the bad years. It's the steadier choice. Next ideas: a Nifty-above-200-day market filter for falling years, and a test on Nifty 200 to see whether the 4-hour result holds outside Nifty 50.
